onboarding.about.title: About you
onboarding.about.role.title: Your role
onboarding.about.agent.title: Your agent
onboarding.about.source.title: How you found us
onboarding.agents.subtitle: Bring the subscription you already pay for. No API keys, no extra fees for usage.
onboarding.otherAgent.claude.needs: Needs a Claude Pro or Max plan. You sign in once in your browser.
onboarding.otherAgent.codex.needs: Needs a ChatGPT plan. Onlook downloads its agent and you sign in.
onboarding.otherAgent.claude.ready: Claude is set up on this Mac.
onboarding.otherAgent.codex.ready: ChatGPT is set up on this Mac.
onboarding.import.title: Create your first workspace
onboarding.import.subtitle: Design against real code, with everything you make kept in sync with it. Choose where to start.
onboarding.setup.claude.detail.invalidCo: That code was not accepted. Try pasting it again.
onboarding.setup.claude.detail.serverRej: The server turned the sign-in away.
onboarding.setup.claude.detail.spawn: Claude could not be started from here.
onboarding.setup.claude.detail.didNotAns: Claude did not answer in time. The sign-in itself may be fine.
onboarding.setup.claude.detail.tookTooLo: The sign-in took too long and was stopped.
onboarding.setup.claude.detail.exited: The sign-in stopped before it finished.
onboarding.setup.claude.detail.turnSigne: Claude answered that this computer is not signed in.
onboarding.setup.claude.detail.turnSignI: Claude turned this sign-in away. It may have expired, or been signed out on another device.
onboarding.setup.claude.usageLimit.title: Your Claude plan’s limit is used up
onboarding.setup.claude.usageLimit.body: Your sign-in works, but Claude answered Onlook’s test message with a usage limit. It didn’t say when the limit resets; your Claude account’s usage page shows it.
onboarding.setup.claude.usageLimit.sessi: Your sign-in works, but your Claude plan’s 5-hour limit is used up until {when}.
onboarding.setup.claude.usageLimit.weekl: Your sign-in works, but your weekly Claude limit is used up until {when}.
onboarding.setup.claude.usageLimit.until: Your sign-in works, but your Claude limit is used up until {when}.
onboarding.setup.claude.rateLimited.body: Claude says this account has sent too many requests, and didn’t say for how long. Waiting a minute often clears it.
onboarding.setup.claude.billing.title: Claude can’t bill this account
onboarding.setup.claude.billing.body: Your sign-in works, but Claude says this account has no plan or credits it can use. Onlook runs on your own Claude plan. Fix it in your Claude account, then check again.
onboarding.setup.claude.signInRejected.b: It may have expired, or been signed out on another device. Signing in again usually fixes it.
onboarding.setup.claude.noAnswer.title: Claude didn’t answer
onboarding.setup.claude.noAnswer.body: Onlook sent Claude a short test message and heard nothing back in 30 seconds. Claude’s service may be slow, or the connection dropped.
onboarding.setup.claude.serviceError.bod: Claude is overloaded right now. This is on Claude’s side; checking again usually works within a minute.
onboarding.setup.claude.agentError.title: Claude answered with an error
onboarding.setup.claude.agentError.body: Onlook doesn’t recognise this one. Here’s what Claude said.
onboarding.setup.claude.agentError.silen: Onlook doesn’t recognise this one, and Claude didn’t say why.
onboarding.setup.claude.notSignedIn.titl: Sign in to Claude to continue
onboarding.setup.claude.notSignedIn.body: Onlook opens claude.com in your browser.
onboarding.setup.claude.signingIn.title: Finish signing in to Claude in your browser
onboarding.setup.claude.signingIn.body: We are waiting for it. Come back when the page says you are done.
onboarding.setup.claude.pasteCode.title: Claude showed you a code
onboarding.setup.claude.pasteCode.body: Paste it here and you are done.
onboarding.setup.claude.checking.title: Checking it works
onboarding.setup.claude.checking.body: Onlook is sending Claude one short message to make sure it answers.
onboarding.setup.claude.cannotConnect.bo: Onlook sent Claude a short message and it did not go through.
onboarding.setup.claude.fallback.title: Finish signing in from the Terminal
onboarding.setup.claude.fallback.body: Copy the line below, paste it into Terminal, and press Return. Come back here when Claude says you are signed in.
onboarding.setup.codex.notSetUp.title: Set up the ChatGPT agent
onboarding.setup.codex.notSetUp.body: Onlook installs its own copy of the ChatGPT agent. Nothing else on your machine changes.
onboarding.setup.codex.downloading.title: Downloading the ChatGPT agent
onboarding.setup.codex.downloading.body: About 111 MB. It only takes about 30 seconds.
onboarding.setup.codex.checking.title: Checking it works
onboarding.setup.codex.checking.body: Onlook is checking the agent answers and that this computer is signed in.
onboarding.setup.codex.notSignedIn.title: Sign in to ChatGPT to finish
onboarding.setup.codex.notSignedIn.body: Onlook opens chatgpt.com in your browser. This replaces any other OpenAI credentials saved on this computer.
onboarding.setup.codex.signingIn.title: Finish signing in to ChatGPT in your browser
onboarding.setup.codex.signingIn.body: This closes on its own once you’ve signed in.
onboarding.setup.codex.setupFailed.title: Setting up the ChatGPT agent did not finish
onboarding.setup.codex.setupFailed.body: It can be picked up from where it stopped.
onboarding.setup.codex.wontStart.title: The ChatGPT agent downloaded but will not start
onboarding.setup.codex.wontStart.body: Downloading a fresh copy usually fixes it.
onboarding.setup.codex.outOfDate.title: The ChatGPT agent on this computer is older than Onlook needs
onboarding.setup.codex.outOfDate.body: It runs, but Onlook drives a newer version. The download is the current one.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.unsupporte: The ChatGPT agent is not published for {platform}/{arch}.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.metadata: Could not read the ChatGPT agent’s release metadata.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.prepare: Could not prepare the folder the ChatGPT agent downloads into.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.integrity: The ChatGPT agent download failed its integrity check.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.unusable: The downloaded ChatGPT agent is not one we can drive.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.noVersion: Could not read the ChatGPT agent’s version from the handshake.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.home: ChatGPT cannot access its settings folder. Check that CODEX_HOME points to a writable folder, then try again.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.startup: The ChatGPT agent could not start. Check your Codex settings, then try again. Downloading another copy may not help.
onboarding.setup.codex.detail.outdated: This ChatGPT agent is {version}; Onlook needs {floor} or newer.
onboarding.setup.codex.fallback.title: Finish signing in from the Terminal
onboarding.setup.codex.fallback.body: ChatGPT sign-in did not finish. Copy the line below, paste it into Terminal, and press Return. Choose Check again after ChatGPT says you are signed in.
onboarding.chat.signIn.claude: Please sign in to Claude to continue designing in Onlook
onboarding.chat.signIn.codex: Please sign in to ChatGPT to continue designing in Onlook
onboarding.chat.notice.signedOutBody: Claude says this computer isn’t signed in anymore. Your chat and changes are kept.
